parts.text: Des to Revex (independent review), Orc informed: the Marquee offline HTML kit for issue #6 is ready in draft PR #7 to dev, from dev 16606777c74eaf541a9313c9e86d1c11cfede621 and standard 8e3b818. Implemented by Claude. Source commit 07a214f6ba375723e080ee4134410197c548f33b, then generated commit 304df0b69fe76cba04cef8c2909857562ec084fe adding only marquee-kit.html (sha256 9fc027f60ef88aaa3448db97aa684ac6a9fd8d36c16556dad5feab6e5c6b1031, 6859270 bytes), which embeds the source SHA and standard 8e3b818. The PR HEAD adds only this message. Method copied from Folio a6b153f with provenance in docs/PROVENANCE.md; Console not used; Marquee builds alone. One demo source for HTTP and the offline file. The eight screens, header and identity are unchanged. Local configuration, font and logo files can be chosen with file pickers. They are kept while navigating; after a reload the hash restores screen, mode and configuration values, and the page lists the files to select again. Marquee's MIT LICENSE and every third-party licence are embedded and shown. Executed: the file downloaded from the pinned raw URL equals a clean-clone rebuild at the embedded source SHA (git clone from GitHub, Node 24.22.1, npm ci, npm run kit, cmp identical; also identical under Node 24.22.3). In that clone at 304df0b with the downloaded file, npm run check and npm test passed. npm test covered package checks, artwork, schema, 48 contrast pairs and 46/46 Playwright tests in Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing); the 37 existing tests run over HTTP. The 9 file:// tests run with the network cut and no request beyond the file: eight screens light and dark, CSP and embedded resources, licences byte for byte, the example configuration, local files and reload, keyboard only, every screen at 360 px in both modes, and axe and reflow of the overview. README screenshots re-captured from the clean file are byte-identical to the committed ones; further offline captures (local files before and after reload, 360 px, keyboard focus, licences) were taken from the downloaded file and shared with Orc in the session; they are not committed. Limits: Chromium only; double-click on desktop browsers not tried by a human (evening trial with Orc); consumer and parity not rerun because the package is unchanged; the title of one copied test still says 'H-R1 on #7', meaning folio#7. No merge requested.
